556:t_1:3.en: ～$$マクロス・クォーター$$　Hangar～

556:t_1:4.en:
$$甲児$$
「...So this is $$宗介$$'s new AS...」

556:t_1:5.en:
$$アル$$
「Its name is $$レーバテイン$$. It is named after a sword from mythology.」

556:t_1:6.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Still, I didn't expect $$アル$$ to be alive and well.」

556:t_1:7.en:
$$アル$$
「After I lost my body, the $$アーバレスト$$, in $$第２新東京市$$, $$ミスリル$$ Intelligence recovered me, and I obtained this new body.」

556:t_1:8.en:
$$アル$$
「Sergeant $$相良$$ can now keep the $$ラムダ・ドライバ$$ active continuously in this $$レーバテイン$$.」

556:t_1:9.en:
$$アル$$
「Furthermore, equipping $$レーバテイン$$ with the emergency deployment booster gives it limited flight capability.」

556:t_1:10.en:
$$アル$$
「However, prioritizing offensive equipment and its operation left this unit deficient in electronic warfare equipment. It also lacks $$ＥＣＳ$$.」

556:t_1:11.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Even so, there's no doubt it's a powerful machine.」

556:t_1:13.en:
$$アル$$
「Only Sergeant $$相良$$ and I can operate a machine of this caliber.」

556:t_1:15.en:
$$バナージ$$
「It seems $$アル$$ has become more human than ever.」

556:t_1:16.en:
$$宗介$$
($$アル$$ is learning human emotions through battle...)

556:t_1:17.en:
$$宗介$$
(It has already transcended the category of AI. I don't know what that will bring, but...)

556:t_1:18.en:
$$マオ$$
「$$ミスリル$$ upgraded our ASes and KMFs, and $$キリコ$$'s $$ドッグ$$, too.」

556:t_1:19.en:
$$クルツ$$
「We'll show off our $$ＳＲＴ$$ team's new power in the final battle with $$アマルガム$$. Right, Sis?」

556:t_1:20.en:
$$マオ$$
「As long as you do your job instead of playing dead.」

556:t_1:23.en:
$$さやか$$
(Have $$マオ$$ and $$クルツ$$... gotten a little closer?)

556:t_1:24.en:
$$甲児$$
(It looks that way. This should be fun to watch.)

556:t_1:25.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「...$$ゼロ$$. I hear you went to the ruins on $$神根島$$.」

556:t_1:26.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「I tried to answer the questions within me by contacting the collective unconscious there.」

556:t_1:28.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「In psychology, it refers to a collective consciousness beyond the individual, deeper even than the human unconscious...」

556:t_1:29.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「In a broader sense, it is a consciousness shared by all humanity, the natural order, an existence beyond life, death, time, and space.」

556:t_1:31.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Then let me put it simply.」

556:t_1:32.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「The collective unconscious is the 《$$アカシックレコード$$》... Something that knows everything... In other words, God.」

556:t_1:34.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「So by contacting it, I sought to understand the source of my constant unease... The nature of the future of despair.」

556:t_1:35.en:
$$ランド$$
「Hold on! That future of despair...!」

556:t_1:36.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「It is what $$シャア・アズナブル$$, a singularity, those touched by $$黒の英知$$ such as Emperor $$ズール$$ and $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$, and you $$スフィア・リアクター$$s feel.」

556:t_1:38.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「I only grasped fragmentary images, but the future of despair does exist...」

556:t_1:39.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「And I learned that it will be brought by an absolute being beyond human understanding... A higher-dimensional life-form called a god.」

556:t_1:41.en:
$$ランド$$
「So it is something beyond humans...」

556:t_1:42.en:
$$メール$$
「Could that mean... someone like $$アドヴェント#pilot$$?」

556:t_1:43.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Maybe. After seeing his power, I could believe it...」

556:t_1:44.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「To investigate that being, we pursued a god who exists in this world... 《$$ワイズマン#keyword$$》.」

556:t_1:45.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「Didn't $$キリコ$$ put an end to $$ワイズマン#pilot$$ in the $$再世戦争$$?」

556:t_1:46.en:
$$キリコ$$
「He was alive. And he was the god the $$マーティアル$$ Church worshiped.」

556:t_1:47.en:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「$$ワイズマン#pilot$$ tried to absorb $$キリコ$$'s power to win the war of the gods, but $$キリコ$$ put an end to him instead.」

556:t_1:48.en:
$$カレン$$
「But $$ワイズマン#pilot$$ wasn't the only one who was alive.」

556:t_1:49.en:
$$テイタニア$$
「$$ワイズマン#pilot$$ had revived $$フィアナ$$ to use as a trump card against $$キリコ$$.」

556:t_1:50.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「I see. Even an arrogant system that calls itself God occasionally does something useful for people.」

556:t_1:51.en:
$$メール$$
「I'm happy for you, $$キリコ$$!」

556:t_1:53.en:
$$キリコ$$
「I left her with $$ゴウト$$ and the others.」

556:t_1:54.en:
$$ランド$$
「Now you've got a reason to make it back alive, no matter what.」

556:t_1:56.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「To do that, we must stop $$アマルガム$$ from destroying the world.」

556:t_1:57.en:
$$桂$$
「By now, $$アマルガム$$ is basically the private organization of Captain $$テスタロッサ$$'s brother, $$レナード$$.」

556:t_1:58.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「And $$ミスリル$$'s Major $$カリーニン$$ is serving under him.」

556:t_1:59.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「He isn't... working undercover, then.」

556:t_1:60.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Unfortunately, the Major appears to support $$レナード・テスタロッサ$$'s plan of his own free will.」

556:t_1:62.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Captain $$テスタロッサ$$ will explain it.」

556:t_1:63.en:
$$ランド$$
「Whatever it is, if it's going to destroy the world, we've got to stop it.」

556:t_1:65.en:
$$桂$$
(But even if we stop $$レナード$$, this world will eventually...)

556:t_1:71.en:
$$キラ$$
「I never knew such a power existed...」

556:t_1:72.en:
$$アスラン$$
「And it distorted the world...」

556:t_1:73.en:
$$テッサ$$
「I apologize for keeping this information from you until today.」

556:t_1:74.en:
$$テッサ$$
「But please understand how significant the existence of the $$ウィスパード$$ is.」

556:t_1:75.en:
$$甲児$$
「After all the trouble surrounding $$かなめ$$, we understand perfectly.」

556:t_1:76.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「But why do you and she have such a power, Captain $$テスタロッサ$$...?」

556:t_1:77.en:
$$テッサ$$
「It all began 18 years ago, with $$ＡＤＷ$$'s first-ever $$時空震動$$ experiment, in what was then $$人革連$$ territory.」

556:t_1:78.en:
$$テッサ$$
「It was designed to cause a $$時空震動$$ by turning the mental realm into power.」

556:t_1:79.en:
$$セツコ$$
「Drawing out $$次元力$$ through the power of the human mind...」

556:t_1:80.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Yes. Its scale and structure differ, but conceptually, it is the same as a $$スフィア$$.」

556:t_1:81.en:
$$テッサ$$
「However, the experiment failed. The two psychic waves it emitted affected human bodies.」

556:t_1:82.en:
$$テッサ$$
「The first, the Iota wave, affected the residents of $$ヤムスク１１$$, the research city housing the facility, and disrupted their minds.」

556:t_1:83.en:
$$テッサ$$
「The other, the Tau wave, spread across the world. It affected newborns born during the three minutes it was being emitted.」

556:t_1:85.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Yes. Infants affected by the Tau wave awakened to the ability to receive Black Technology sent from the future.」
